import csv
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from invoice import export_csv, total

INVOICE_PY = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "invoice.py"


def run_cli(*args):
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(INVOICE_PY), *args]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return result.stdout.strip()


def test_total(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "i.json"
    p.write_text('[{"qty": 2, "price": 3}]')
    assert total(str(p)) == 6


def test_export_csv(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "i.json"
    p.write_text('[{"qty": 2, "price": 3}, {"qty": 1, "price": 5, "sku": "a,b"}]')
    out = export_csv(str(p))
    assert out == tmp_path / "i.csv"
    with out.open(newline="") as f:
        assert list(csv.DictReader(f)) == [
            {"qty": "2", "price": "3", "sku": ""},
            {"qty": "1", "price": "5", "sku": "a,b"},
        ]


def test_cli_total(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "i.json"
    p.write_text('[{"qty": 2, "price": 3}]')
    assert run_cli("total", str(p)) == "6"


def test_cli_export_csv(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "i.json"
    p.write_text('[{"qty": 2, "price": 3}]')
    out = tmp_path / "i.csv"
    assert run_cli("export", "--csv", str(p)) == str(out)
    assert out.read_text().splitlines() == ["qty,price", "2,3"]
